verdict.rationale: First-party marketing states Ubuntu offers 'thousands of applications', names popular ones (Firefox, Chrome, Discord, Steam, OBS Studio), and says it is 'backed by the full Ubuntu archive for packages and updates'. Together these show an official, large software catalog. Missing for 10: any documentation of the actual catalog install experience (e.g., App Center/store front-end or package-manager workflow), and independent or hands-on corroboration of installing from the official catalog.
